description: This is a Java test class containing integration tests for the SearchActor component within the Eclipse Ditto project. It tests search and stream functionalities, including cursor-based pagination, by setting up MongoDB resources, initializing testing actors, and verifying search results.

classes.name: SearchActorIT
classes.description: Integration test class for SearchActor in Eclipse Ditto project, testing search and stream functionalities with mock MongoDB database and Akka actors.

methods.name: startMongoResource
methods.description: Initializes the MongoDB resource and query parser before all tests.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Sets up the actor system, persistence layers, and MongoDB collection before each test.

methods.name: provideReadPersistence
methods.description: Creates and initializes the MongoDB search persistence layer.

methods.name: provideWritePersistence
methods.description: Provides a test implementation for search update streaming.

methods.name: provideClientWrapper
methods.description: Creates a MongoDB client wrapper configured to connect to the test MongoDB instance.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Cleans up resources after each test, dropping collections and shutting down actor systems.

methods.name: stopMongoResource
methods.description: Shuts down the MongoDB resource and closes clients after all tests.

methods.name: testSearch
methods.description: Tests search functionality by inserting test 'things' and verifying returned IDs.

methods.name: testStream
methods.description: Tests streaming search results using Akka SourceRef, verifying streamed IDs.

methods.name: testCursorSearch
methods.description: Tests cursor-based pagination by executing sequential search requests and checking returned items.

methods.name: queryThings
methods.description: Helper to construct search query commands with optional size and cursor parameters.

methods.name: insertTestThings
methods.description: Inserts test 'Thing' objects into the database for testing.

methods.name: expectedIds
methods.description: Returns expected IDs as JSON array for given ordinal indices.

methods.name: wrapAsSearchResult
methods.description: Wraps a 'thing' ID into a JSON object for search result representation.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Creates a 'Thing' object with specific attributes for test purposes.
